doc.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017

chapter: Early gigs and the war years
title: Day jobs outside music
summary: He worked construction, shipping clerk and department store jobs but disliked combining them with gigs.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Did you ever have to, or choose to, work a day job outside music?

Yeah I’ve the daytime, yeah. I’ve worked construction work, I’ve worked as a shipping clerk, I’ve worked, let’s see, department store. That’s about all I can think of right now. But I didn’t really like that so much, working, in one thing and then playing after that. That really didn’t strike up too good on me.
Yeah. It makes it hard on your family life too.
